u0101.line: Germany and the Netherlands announced a new NATO 'tactical headquarters' in the Baltic region (May 2026).

u0102.line: 79th World Health Assembly (WHA) → Geneva, Switzerland (18–23 May 2026).

u0103.line: United Arab Emirates (UAE) decided to formally withdraw from OPEC (Organization of the Petroleum Exporting Countries) with effect from 1 May 2026.

u0104.line: Shanghai Cooperation Organisation (SCO) defence ministers' meeting → Bishkek, Kyrgyzstan (28 April 2026).

u0105.line: Global Report on Food Crises 2026 (GRFC): Pakistan among the top 10 countries with the most people facing high acute food insecurity (April 2026).

u0106.line: India hosted the first meeting of the 'BRICS Health Working Group' in 2026 → New Delhi (April 2026).

u0107.line: South Korean President Lee Jae Myung paid a state visit to India (19–21 April 2026); focus sectors with PM Modi: semiconductors and shipbuilding.

u0108.line: 9th Indian Ocean Conference (IOC 2026) → hosted by Mauritius (10–12 April 2026); theme: 'Collective Stewardship for Indian Ocean Governance'.

u0110.line: Uchral Nyam-Osor → assumed office as Prime Minister of Mongolia (30 March 2026).

u0111.line: Global Terrorism Index, 13th edition, by Institute for Economics & Peace (IEP) (21 March 2026): Pakistan most affected; India 13th among 163 countries.

u0112.line: World Happiness Report 2026: Finland first for the ninth consecutive year; Iceland second, Denmark third; India 116th among 147 countries.

u0113.line: Mobile World Congress (MWC) 2026 → Barcelona, Spain (2–5 March 2026).

u0114.line: Corruption Perceptions Index 2025 by Transparency International (headquarters Berlin, Germany): India 91st among 182 countries (released February 2026).
u0114.trap: The index is named 2025 but was released in February 2026.

u0115.line: Fourth India–Tanzania Joint Defence Cooperation Committee (JDCC) meeting → Zanzibar, Tanzania (Feb 2026); India led by Amitabh Prasad, Joint Secretary (Defence Cooperation); Tanzania by Ibrahim Mhona.
u0115.trap: Amitabh Prasad led the Indian side; Ibrahim Mhona led the Tanzanian side.

u0116.line: World Governments Summit (WGS) 2026 → Dubai, UAE (3–5 February 2026); theme 'Shaping Future Governments'.

u0117.line: PM Narendra Modi → visited Malaysia (7–8 Feb 2026).

u0118.line: Lowy Institute (Australia) Asia Power Index 2025: USA first, China second, India third. First IIT campus in West Africa proposed in Nigeria.

u0119.line: World Health Organization (WHO) declared a polio outbreak over in Indonesia (November 2025).

u0120.line: Miss Universe 2025 → Fátima Bosch of Mexico (21 Nov 2025). Cambridge Dictionary Word of the Year 2025 → 'parasocial'.

u0121.line: World Telecommunication Development Conference 2025 (WTDC-25) → Baku, Azerbaijan (17–28 November 2025).

u0122.line: Third International Ayurveda Conference → São Paulo, Brazil (14–15 November 2025).

u0123.line: India ranked 23rd in the Climate Change Performance Index 2026 (released November 2025).
u0123.trap: The index is named 2026 but came out in November 2025.

u0124.line: Nine core industries index grew 7.9% in September 2026; revised base year 2022–23; nine = coal, crude oil, natural gas, refinery products, fertilisers, steel, cement, electricity, iron ore.
u0124.check: Q287 says 'Nine core industries' but Q288 calls it the 'Index of Eight Core Industries'.

u0125.line: Cabinet continued National Social Assistance Programme (2026–27 to 2030–31) as Pradhan Mantri Samajik Sahayata Yojana: outlay ₹53,428 crore; ~3.20 crore beneficiaries; disability pension needs 40% disability.
u0125.trap: ₹53,428 crore is the outlay; 3.20 crore is the number of beneficiaries.

u0126.line: Cabinet approved ₹10,000 crore government commitment for a Small and Medium Enterprise Growth Fund (6 Oct 2026); it gives growth capital as direct equity investment.

u0127.line: Petroleum Minister Hardeep Singh Puri launched Central Gobardhan Scheme (1 Oct 2026): outlay ₹23,731 crore; FY 2026–27 to 2035–36; focus: compressed biogas.
u0127.hook: Gobar-dhan: cow dung (गोबर) turned into wealth (धन) as biogas.

u0128.line: MSP for marketing season 2027–28 (30 Sept 2026): all mandated rabi crops raised; safflower got highest increase ₹675/quintal; safflower MSP now ₹7,215/quintal.
u0128.trap: ₹675 is safflower's increase; ₹7,215 is safflower's full MSP.

u0129.line: Fourth Uttar Pradesh International Trade Show 2026 → India Expo Centre and Mart, Greater Noida (25 to 29 September 2026).

u0130.line: NITI Aayog released the second edition of the India Electric Mobility Index (16 Sept 2026); reference year 2025.
u0130.trap: Released in 2026, but the reference year is 2025.

u0131.line: World Circular Economy Forum 2026 → Mahatma Mandir Convention Centre, Gandhinagar, Gujarat; the Forum began as an initiative of Finland's innovation fund 'Sitra'.

u0132.line: Union Minister of Ports, Shipping and Waterways Sarbananda Sonowal → launched the Logistics Port Performance Index (LPPI) for FY 2024–25 (29 May 2026).

u0133.line: Union Cabinet approved BHAVYA (Bharat Audyogik Vikas Yojna) for industrial parks (March 2026); outlay ₹33,660 crore; operational guidelines by DPIIT.

u0134.line: Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman tabled Economic Survey 2025–26 (29 Jan 2026); prepared by the Economic Division, Department of Economic Affairs, Ministry of Finance.

u0135.line: Union Budget 2026–27 (1 Feb 2026), Nirmala Sitharaman: total expenditure ₹53,47,315 crore; fiscal deficit 4.3% of GDP; revenue deficit 1.5%; nominal GDP growth 10%; effective capex ₹17,14,523 crore.
u0135.trap: Fiscal deficit = 4.3% of GDP; revenue deficit = 1.5% of GDP. Total expenditure (₹53,47,315 crore) is not the effective capital expenditure (₹17,14,523 crore).

u0136.line: Budget 2026–27 announced 7 high-speed rail corridors, total length nearly 4,000 km.

u0137.line: NHAI set Guinness World Records while building a six-lane highway on the Bengaluru–Kadapa–Vijayawada Economic Corridor (NH-544G) (6 Jan 2026).

u0138.line: Assam → first state to constitute its Eighth Pay Commission (February 2026); Chairman: Subhash Chandra Das.

u0139.line: Export Promotion Mission (approved November 2025; outlay ₹25,060 crore; 2025–26 to 2030–31): two interventions under niryat protsahan sub-scheme to boost MSME exports (Jan 2026).

u0140.line: Lucknow → first city in Uttar Pradesh to become a 'Zero Fresh Waste Dump City' (21 January 2026).

u0141.line: Union Cabinet approved ₹5,000 crore equity support for SIDBI (Small Industries Development Bank of India) (21 January 2026).

u0142.line: Joint military exercise 'Mountain Guardian-2026' → India and the UAE at Chaubattia, Uttarakhand (5–18 October 2026).

u0143.line: ISRO announced the fourth Announcement of Opportunity cycle for Aditya-L1 solar observations (16 Oct 2026); it studies the Sun near L1; over 37 terabytes of data public.

u0144.line: ISRO completed Gaganyaan Crew Module–Service Module separation tests at Vikram Sarabhai Space Centre, Thiruvananthapuram (16 October 2026).

u0145.line: Navy's first indigenous multipurpose vessel 'Samarthak' → delivered 27 Aug 2026, commissioned 16 Oct 2026; built by Larsen & Toubro at Kattupalli, Tamil Nadu.
u0145.trap: Delivered on 27 August; commissioned on 16 October.

u0146.line: NASA's revised Artemis plan (14 Oct 2026): return human Moon landing targeted by 2028; revised Artemis-III to send four astronauts into low Earth orbit.
u0146.trap: Artemis-III goes to low Earth orbit; the Moon landing target is 2028.

u0147.line: Ninth 'Kazind-2026' joint military exercise → India and Kazakhstan, at Oskemen, Kazakhstan (28 Sept–11 Oct 2026).

u0148.line: India's first high-altitude snow leopard wildlife safari → launched in Ladakh (7 October 2026).

u0149.line: Technology Development Board – BigEndian Semiconductors (Bengaluru) deal for indigenous AI vision chip under 'Project VeerAI': ₹130 crore from RDI Fund; total cost ₹260 crore.
u0149.hook: 130 × 2 = 260: the fund gives half the cost.
u0149.trap: ₹130 crore = assistance; ₹260 crore = total project cost.

u0150.line: Second ASEAN–India Maritime Exercise 'AIME-2026' concluded in the Philippines (3 Oct 2026); Indian ships: INS Sahyadri and INS Kulish.
